Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000610" [constraint]: The ledger service deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000599" [constraint]: As of 2025-08-19, deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC; the old Tuesday 13:00-15:00 UTC window is retired.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000312" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the webhook dispatcher deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC.  (about: webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000340" [constraint]: Deploys to the bus happen on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC and at no other time.  (about: the bus)
- memory_id "1000212" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the authentication gateway deploys on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000033": The ledger service is owned by the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000279" [constraint]: The reporting service only ships on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: reporting service)
- memory_id "1000623" [constraint]: The product catalog deploys on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000687": Until 2025-09-23, the reporting service depended on the ledger service for the nightly balance export; it no longer depends on the ledger service.  (about: ledger service, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000161" [constraint]: The ledger service must stay on Postgres 14 until the partitioning work finishes.  (about: ledger service, Postgres 14)
- memory_id "1000225": Boreal noticed the ledger service's memory use growth after the cache change and pinged the ledger service's owners.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000430": INC-2025-011 was a ledger service incident on 2025-05-24.  (about: ledger service, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000195" [constraint]: The billing API only ships on weekdays after 15:00 UTC.  (about: billing API)
- memory_id "1000682": As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service uses the bus as its source instead of the ledger service, because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs.  (about: ledger service, billing API, the bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000362": feature-flags' p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.  (about: feature-flags, Tuesday's deploy)
- memory_id "1000526" [decision]: From 2025-06-09, the billing API is owned by the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, billing API)
- memory_id "1000248": The ledger service depends on the auth gateway for service tokens.  (about: ledger service, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000561" [decision]: As of 2025-07-30, Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team and Tomasz is no longer the primary on-call.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000438" [decision]: Ledger service migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000221": The ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: ledger service, the cache change)
Existing entity names: ledger service, job scheduler, webhook dispatcher, the bus, authentication gateway, Atlas team, reporting service, product catalog, Postgres 14, Boreal team, INC-2025-011, billing API, feature-flags, Tuesday's deploy, auth gateway, Priya Raman, Tomasz, the cache change
